sentence.text: Assign P1 priority when a report describes an immediate safety concern or a widespread inability to use the ride service. Assign P2 priority to a blocked account or an incorrect charge that prevents a rider or driver from continuing normal service use.
sentence.title: Ticket-priority classification rules

sentence.text: Assign P3 priority to a nonblocking technical issue or product defect, and assign P4 priority to a general inquiry or feedback request. When several conditions apply, record the highest priority and the facts that justify it without treating VIP status as a safety severity.
sentence.title: Ticket-priority classification rules

sentence.text: For P1 severity, acknowledge within 15 elapsed minutes and target resolution or a documented workaround within 4 elapsed hours. For P2 severity, acknowledge within 1 support hour and target resolution within 24 support hours.
sentence.title: SLA-by-severity policy

sentence.text: For P3 severity, acknowledge within 4 support hours and target resolution within 72 support hours; for P4 severity, acknowledge within 8 support hours and target resolution within 120 support hours. These SLA targets use the business-hours policy for support-hour calculations and require an update before a deadline is missed, while external dependencies must be documented rather than presented as guaranteed completion times.
sentence.title: SLA-by-severity policy

sentence.text: Route billing and refund disputes to the billing specialist, technical issues and product defects to the technical specialist, and account-access failures to the account-security specialist. Escalate a P1 safety report immediately to the duty incident lead, who coordinates the responsible specialist and emergency guidance when appropriate.
sentence.title: Escalation matrix

sentence.text: Escalate a P2 ticket to the support supervisor if its acknowledgement deadline is missed, and escalate any unresolved ticket before its resolution target expires. The receiving owner must accept the handoff, and the original owner remains responsible for customer updates until acceptance is recorded.
sentence.title: Escalation matrix

sentence.text: A billing specialist may approve a refund after verifying a duplicate charge, a confirmed overcharge, or a charge for a service that was not delivered. Refund only the verified incorrect amount to the original payment method, with a target processing time of 5 to 7 business days after approval.
sentence.title: Refund and compensation policy

sentence.text: A support supervisor may approve goodwill compensation up to INR 200 for a documented service failure, while larger compensation requires the operations manager's approval. Do not promise a refund or compensation before approval, and record whether a service credit already covers the same loss to prevent duplicate reimbursement.
sentence.title: Refund and compensation policy

sentence.text: Use in-app support as the primary communication channel for rider and driver ticket updates, with email as the alternative when account access is unavailable. A support agent may offer a callback for an urgent issue only after the customer requests or consents to the call.
sentence.title: Customer communication channel policy

sentence.text: Before sharing ticket details on an alternative channel, complete the approved account-verification process and avoid exposing another customer's information. Never request an OTP, full payment-card details, or an account password, and keep every customer update attached to the ticket record.
sentence.title: Customer communication channel policy

sentence.text: Standard support hours are 09:00 to 18:00 Asia/Kolkata from Monday through Saturday, excluding holidays listed in the team's published support calendar. Support-hour SLA clocks pause outside those hours and resume at the next opening, while business-day refund processing uses Monday through Friday excluding listed holidays.
sentence.title: Business-hours and holiday-support policy

sentence.text: P1 safety and major-outage reports reach the on-call team at all times, including Sundays and holidays, and use elapsed-time SLA clocks. For other requests received outside standard hours, acknowledge receipt automatically and state when staffed support resumes without promising immediate resolution.
sentence.title: Business-hours and holiday-support policy

sentence.text: Treat a report as a repeat complaint when the same customer reports the same underlying issue within 30 days of the earlier ticket. Link the new report to the earlier ticket and reopen that ticket when the previous resolution has not held, preserving the original history.
sentence.title: Repeat-complaint handling policy

sentence.text: Assign a support supervisor to review the root cause on the second repeat, and raise priority when the facts show greater impact rather than because of complaint count alone. Tell the customer which owner is investigating and avoid asking for evidence already present in the linked history.
sentence.title: Repeat-complaint handling policy

sentence.text: A support supervisor may approve a noncash service credit up to INR 150 for a verified service interruption when a cash refund does not already compensate the same loss. Apply an approved service credit to the customer's fabricated capstone account balance, with validity of 30 days from issuance.
sentence.title: Service-credit policy

sentence.text: Service credits cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash, and a credit above INR 150 requires the operations manager's approval. Record the reason, approval, amount and expiry in the ticket and communicate those terms before issuing the credit.
sentence.title: Service-credit policy

sentence.text: After a ticket is resolved, offer one optional in-app feedback survey asking for a satisfaction rating from 1 to 5 and a short comment. If the customer does not respond, send at most one reminder after 48 hours and do not make feedback a condition of receiving support.
sentence.title: Feedback-collection process

sentence.text: A rating of 1 or 2 or a comment indicating an unresolved issue triggers a supervisor review of the resolution. Store feedback against the ticket using the ticket-retention policy, and report aggregated themes without identifying individual customers.
sentence.title: Feedback-collection process

sentence.text: Identify VIP eligibility only from a verified account flag rather than from a customer's claim in a message. Assign an eligible VIP ticket a named support owner and provide an update at least every 4 support hours while work remains open.
sentence.title: VIP-customer handling policy

sentence.text: VIP handling does not change safety priority, refund eligibility, compensation limits, or the requirement to verify account access. When a VIP complaint remains unresolved at its normal SLA deadline, the named owner must involve the support supervisor and communicate the next review time.
sentence.title: VIP-customer handling policy

sentence.text: When monitoring or multiple validated tickets confirm an outage, the duty incident lead opens an incident record and identifies the affected service and regions. Publish an initial in-app notice within 15 elapsed minutes of incident confirmation and update it every 30 elapsed minutes while disruption continues.
sentence.title: Outage-communication protocol

sentence.text: Each notice must distinguish confirmed impact from investigation findings and provide only verified workarounds, with no unconfirmed restoration promise. After recovery is verified, publish a recovery notice and attach a factual incident summary to related support tickets within 2 business days.
sentence.title: Outage-communication protocol

sentence.text: Retain a support ticket and its attached communication for 180 days after the ticket is closed, then delete identifying details through the scheduled retention process. For a resolved ticket that remains open, the support owner must either close it after confirming resolution or document why further work is required rather than leave it indefinitely unresolved.
sentence.title: Data-retention policy for tickets

sentence.text: Restrict ticket access to staff assigned to support duties, and use masked phone numbers in diagnostic logs. An authorized legal hold pauses deletion only for the affected records, must be documented and reviewed every 30 days, and allows deletion to resume after the hold is released.
sentence.title: Data-retention policy for tickets
